## Working session summary

I've fixed the release-notes formatter and repaired all 367 damaged GitHub releases. PR https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/3446 is marked ready for review. CI passes on the final commit (2ba255339).

**Root cause.** The release-notes formatter called `.trim()` on every line. Changesets indents the later paragraphs and nested bullets of an entry by two spaces; that indentation was removed, so they fell out of the bullet. That is why v2.37.1 showed one bullet followed by 19 loose paragraphs.

**Other releases.** I checked all 893 releases against `CHANGELOG.md`:
```text
- 302 had the same lost-indentation bug.
- 102 were missing text:
  - text cut at `---`;
  - the first bullet's marker dropped;
  - a literal `\n` turned into a line break;
  - trailing quotes stripped.
- 37 Minor and Major releases were never formatted at all.
- 6 more differed from `CHANGELOG.md`: manual "Test patch release" entries whose `- ` marker was dropped.
- The credential sanitizer also hid option and code names in the v2.33.5 and v2.33.6 notes.
- The 302 releases before v0.38.9 have no `CHANGELOG.md` section, so there was nothing to check them against.
```

**Fixes.**
- **Shared formatter** (`scripts/format-release-notes.lib.mjs`): now used by both release scripts. It keeps the structure exactly as `CHANGELOG.md` has it.
- **Version lookup:** a version's section is found by the whole heading line, so `2.3.1` no longer picks up `2.3.10`.
- **Manual releases** (`scripts/instant-version-bump.mjs`): a multi-line description is now indented in `CHANGELOG.md` the way Changesets does it.
- **Sanitizer:** the four false positives are fixed. Real tokens next to them are still hidden.
- **Debug output:** both scripts accept `--verbose`.
- **Repair script** (`scripts/repair-release-notes.mjs`): rebuilds published releases from `CHANGELOG.md`. It only reports by default; `--apply` changes the releases.

**Repair.** I fixed v2.37.1 first, then 365 releases in one run with no failures. v2.38.0 was published with the old formatter while this work was in progress, so I repaired it separately. Re-running the check on the live releases now finds 0 problems. The old text of every release is backed up in the case study folder.

**Other changes in the PR:**
- **CI fix:** CI failed because formal-ai 0.354.0 came out during the work, so I updated it in the Dockerfiles and pin tests. I checked that its changes don't touch the health endpoint, `--version` output or server routes.
- **Security scan:** CodeQL flagged one of my new regexes as a slow-input risk. I replaced it with a simpler pattern that matches the same text and added a test; the alert now shows as fixed.
- **Case study:** `docs/case-studies/issue-3445/` has the timeline, requirements, root causes, research, data, repair logs, and before/after screenshots of the v2.37.1 notes.
- **Upstream report:** filed in the template this formatter came from, with a repro, a workaround and a suggested fix: https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/236
- **PR description:** has "Fixes #3445" and the requirements report, all marked done with evidence.

**Things to know:**
- **New releases before merge:** any release published before this PR is merged still goes through the old formatter. If that happens, run `node scripts/repair-release-notes.mjs --apply` once after merging.
- **Local tests:** the full local suite was stopped by the time limit after 246 of 671 test files, so the full-suite evidence is CI. Two tests also fail locally on `main`, so this PR doesn't cause them:
```text
  - `deliberate-draft-restarts-ai-2312`
  - `test-merge-changesets-1452`
```

  All tests related to this change pass locally, as do lint and the format check.
